title: Frame content
description: The UTF-8 JSON inside one decrypted, unpadded frame of a link session: an HTTP-shaped request from the page, a response from the engine, or the next piece of a body too large for one frame. A message is acted on only once its frame with more: false has arrived. One request in flight per session. Content that is not one of these shapes closes the session with PROTOCOL. See CONTRACT.md, Vault channel, Frames.

id.description: 1 for the session's first request, then one more per request.

path.description: A route of the allowlist (CONTRACT.md, Vault channel, Frames), for the session's own item. Anything else is answered 404 NOT_FOUND.

headers.description: Lowercase names. basalt-link-secret (the session's own link secret) and origin (https://portal.basaltvault.app) always; content-type application/json on POST. Any other header is answered 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT.

body.description: The request body text, or its first piece when more is true. Empty for GET. At most 16 KiB in all (413 above).

more.description: True when CONTINUE frames with the rest of the body follow.

id.description: The id of the request it answers.

body.description: The response body text as the loopback pages API sends it, or its first piece. At most 16 MiB in all; a page refuses more (TOO_LARGE).

id.description: The id of the request or response it continues.

body.description: The next piece of the body, appended as is.
